verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an official Python SDK for automation/development (databricks-docs-49) alongside Databricks Connect for IDE-based development against Databricks compute (databricks-docs-47), plus a CLI with REST API wrapper (probe-rt-1). This gives AI-native developers concrete, first-party SDK/tooling to build against. Missing for 10: explicit mention of SDKs for other languages (Go, Java, R) and independent hands-on validation beyond docs/CLI probes.
